description: Electronic interlocking I/O card intermittent; risk of route locking failure at Kanpur Central. Session 1 of 2 (card swap night 1; full route testing night 2).
Multi-section axle counter reset failures; trains running on paper line-clear during peaks. Single session reset + cable test.
IRS point machine throwing time > 4 s; needs overhauling under disconnection. Single session.
Boom locking circuit not proving; engineering + S&T joint block mandatory. Single session.
Cold LED bank on Up home; redundant filament still OK but overdue replacement.
DC track circuit pumping in wet weather; false occupancy, capacity loss ~4 paths/hour. Single-session relay + battery replacement.
Main cable megger < 1 MΩ; replacement of 400 m quad under traffic block. Session 1 of 2 (pull-through night 1; termination + testing night 2).
Route indicator LED dim; not affecting main aspect.
Preparatory reset frequent in fog; medium density but crew complaints high. Single session.
Detection chatter; possible split if not attended before summer expansion. Single session.
Yard berthing track shows occupied; inbound goods held at outer, asset idle. Single session relay + shunt test.
Hot standby mismatch after power dip; division HQ station — treat as emergency. Session 1 of 2 (card replacement + hot-standby bring-up within 4 h night possession).
Two consecutive auto signals degraded; headway increase for MEMU into PRYJ.
Spare quad damaged; main working pair healthy.
Hooter and boom not in correspondence; joint S&T–Engineering window.
Slot circuit voltage drop; can be patched in night shadow without full corridor block.
